heading: Role and capacity of Oversight Board

tree.heading: Actions of Oversight Board
tree.text: For the purposes of this subchapter, the Oversight Board may take any action necessary on behalf of the debtor to prosecute the case of the debtor, including—

children.text: filing a petition under section 2164 of this title;
submitting or modifying a plan of adjustment under sections 2172 and 2173 of this title; or
otherwise generally submitting filings in relation to the case with the court.

tree.heading: Representative of debtor
tree.text: The Oversight Board in a case under this subchapter is the representative of the debtor.
